images.title: Reading an angle
images.purpose: Place the protractor centre on the vertex and one arm on 0, then read where the other arm crosses the scale.
images.composition: One large protractor outline with a single angle drawn inside it, centred with lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: One flat semicircle protractor outline in grey #6B7280 with a centre dot on the vertex O at the middle of the bottom edge. Base arm OA lies along the 0 line on the right. Second arm OB at exactly 80 degrees from OA, in teal #0072B2, with the angle shaded teal. A small amber #E69F00 marker dot where OB crosses the scale, next to the number 80. Exactly 1 protractor, 2 arms, 1 marker.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any of the following: extra scale numbers
images.takeaway: Line up the 0 and the vertex, then read the scale at the second arm.
images.description: A grey protractor with the vertex O at its centre, base arm OA on 0 and arm OB crossing the scale at 80 degrees.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say which point goes on the centre and where to read.

image_decisions.why: Reading an angle with a protractor is one picture of the aligned arm and the reading.
